# MCL 4.2002a Senatorial districts; terms of office beginning after January 1, 2015.
Sec. 2a. This state is divided into 38 senatorial districts. For terms of office beginning on or after January 1, 2015, the districts are constituted and numbered as follows:
DISTRICT 001
Wayne County (part)
Brownstown Township (part)
